{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out invalid age (-1) only for the mean calculation
valid_age_converted = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_age_converted['customer_age'].mean()

# Also compute counts for evidence
n_converted = len(converted_df)
n_invalid_age = len(converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] == -1])
n_valid_age = len(valid_age_converted)

mean_age, n_converted, n_invalid_age, n_valid_age"}
